detail.case: 正例：窗口算占比 + ORDER BY 引用别名
detail.sql_after:
SELECT pay_type_code, SUM(pay_amount) AS total_gmv, SUM(pay_amount) / SUM(SUM(pay_amount)) OVER () AS gmv_ratio
FROM ydsh_dwd.dwd_order
GROUP BY pay_type_code
ORDER BY gmv_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200

detail.case: 正例：JOIN 维表把编码换中文名

SELECT p.pay_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM ydsh_dwd.dwd_order o
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_pay_type p ON o.pay_type_code = p.pay_code
GROUP BY p.pay_name
LIMIT 200

detail.case: 正例：三表 JOIN
detail.sql_after:
SELECT s.province, u.gender, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv
FROM ydsh_dwd.dwd_order o
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN ydsh_dwd.dim_user  u ON o.user_id  = u.user_id
GROUP BY s.province, u.gender
LIMIT 200
